# Tiny Desk Trend (tinydesktrend.com)

> Unofficial fan site about the "Outstanding" Tiny Desk AI video trend (October 2026). Not affiliated with NPR or Tiny Desk Concerts. A photo-to-video generator is planned but not live.

## Guides
- [Where the Tiny Desk AI Trend Came From](https://tinydesktrend.com/guides/what-is-the-tiny-desk-ai-trend/): origin of the meme
- [How to Make an Outstanding Tiny Desk AI Video](https://tinydesktrend.com/guides/how-to-make-outstanding-tiny-desk-ai-video/): how the video is made
- [What Is the Song in the Tiny Desk AI Video?](https://tinydesktrend.com/guides/outstanding-tiny-desk-song/): the song ("Outstanding" by The Gap Band, 1982)
- [FAQ](https://tinydesktrend.com/faq/)
